verification.description:
Check the latest camera-ready PDF before approving. The paper-specific metadata block and exact rendered values are inserted here after the author uploads the camera-ready manuscript.

Baseline checklist:
- Uses jmlr_or.sty.
- Matches the accepted paper except for camera-ready formatting and explicitly approved minor revisions.
- Does not render an Editor line.
- For Accept with minor revision, the requested changes are present and the authors supplied a restricted Camera-ready revision summary Official Comment.

If correction is needed, do not submit this approval. Post a restricted Official Comment to the paper Authors and wait for a corrected upload.

enum: I confirm that the latest camera-ready manuscript satisfies the JMLR camera-ready requirements.
